mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast shield an ally and then dash to/around them; the recast has no additional cost.
mechanics.quote: grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to and around them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.

mechanics.claim: Shields do not stack if cast on the same target twice; only the duration and shield amount are refreshed.
mechanics.quote: The shields do not stack if ''Battle Dance'' is cast on the same target twice. Only the duration and shield amount is refreshed.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast (of the first cast, since the recast is free).
Both casts count as ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
